tasks: Wire the Loadings and Ramps buttons to setView with the matching View value.
Confirm aria-pressed follows the selected view and the section changes.
Switch back to Loadings and verify the three fixed records are preserved.

View state chooses a presentation. It should not replace the loading records.

objective: Derive visible rows from a controlled status selector.
tasks: Derive visible by filtering loadings against filter; all must keep every record.
Confirm Waiting, Loading, and Done each show one matching row.
Return to All and verify the count and table return to three rows.
hints: The select already updates filter; do not store a separate visible array in state.

title: Group loadings by ramp
objective: Render each ramp with its matching visible assignments.
tasks: Replace the ramp placeholder with an article for each ramp.
Inside each article derive assigned from visible by matching item.rampId to ramp.id, then render its rows.
Use stable IDs for keys; confirm All gives R1 two assignments, R2 one, and R3 none.
hints: Map ramps first, then filter visible inside that callback.
Use visible instead of loadings for the row list so the status filter also works in the ramp view.

title: Explain empty ramps and ramp status
objective: Distinguish an available ramp from a filter with no matches.
tasks: Derive allAssigned from the unfiltered loadings for each ramp.
Show Available when there are no assignments, Complete when every assignment is done, Loading when any is loading, otherwise Waiting.
For zero visible rows, show No loadings assigned. for an empty ramp and No matching loadings at this ramp. for a filtered-out assignment.
Choose Done: R1 must remain Waiting, R2 Loading, and R3 Available even though only L-103 matches the filter.
hints: Check length before every: every on an empty array is true.
Use allAssigned for business status and assigned for the displayed filtered rows.
